items.heading: מבאר ראש וגוף דאדם קדמון עד הטבור, אשר בע"ס דראש אין עוד מציאות כלי, ובע"ס דגוף ישנה מציאות כלי א' שנקרא כתר, ועה"ס נבחנות בכלי זה ע"פ התרחקותן מבחינה ד'. ולהיותן בכלי א' נקראות עקודים, ובו י"א ענינים: — אין לנו כח לעסוק קודם עולם האצילות
items.html: *You already know that we have no power to engage with what precedes the emanation of the ten Sefirot, nor to picture 1any image or form whatsoever, but in order to settle the ear we must 2speak by way of allegory and likeness; therefore, even if we do speak of the existence of a picture there above, the matter is only in order to settle the ear.

items.heading: י"ס דאצילות הן אורות וכלים, ובכדי לקשר בשרשן שלמעלה, צריכים לדבר בסדר המדרגה מראש עד סוף
items.html: Indeed, know that 3the ten Sefirot of Atzilut are two matters: the first is the expansion of spirituality, and the second is vessels and organs in which the self expands. And behold, all this must have a root above, for these two phases, and therefore we must speak in the order of the degrees from beginning to end.

items.heading: האורות דגוף דא"ק מפה עד הטבור נקראים עקודים
items.html: *Behold it is written, “And I saw in a dream, and behold, the he-goats that mounted the flock were 4Akudim [ringed], Nekudim [speckled] and Berudim [spotted],” and it is also written, “for I have seen all that Laban does to you.” In this verse all these phases of which we speak here are alluded to, for Laban is the secret of the upper whiteness, which precedes all this emanation, and it is He who makes all these phases — namely Akudim, Nekudim, Berudim — for the need of the emanation that He will emanate after them, which is called by the name Jacob. And He began with Akudim, for they are the lights that issue from the Peh [mouth] of Adam Kadmon, in which the revelation of the existences of the vessels began, being ten lights, inner and surrounding, tied and joined together inside one vessel; and for this reason they are called Akudim, from the phrase “and he bound Isaac,” meaning, and he tied.

items.heading: מהכאת או"מ ואו"פ זה בזה מחוץ לפה, נולדו הויות כלים
items.html: And behold, since the inner lights are joined with 5the surrounding lights joined inside the Peh [mouth], therefore, when they emerge together 6outside the Peh tied together, they 7strike one another and clash with one another, and from their strikings the existences of the phase of vessels were born.

items.heading: קודם עקודים, דהיינו בע"ס דראש א"ק, אין כלים,
items.html: *8Before the existence of Akudim the upper light could not clothe in any vessel, for 9the vessels had no capacity to bear it, and there the light was not clothed in a vessel, 10until the expansion of that great light reached the phase of Akudim, and there the existence of one vessel was made for that great light; and then 20the emanation began to have in it some existence of a limitation of the light, 30which could not have been the case until now.

items.heading: כלי דעקודים ה"ס כתר. למטה מעקודים יצאו יוד כלים כח"ב תו"מ ובעקודים נעשתה מציאות כלי אחד לע"ס
items.html: Indeed, at first the whole light of the parts that reach emanation was entirely concealed inside one vessel alone, and that vessel had in it the phase of a vessel of the upper Keter [crown]. Afterwards the light expanded further below the aforementioned phase, which is called Akudim, and then ten vessels were made.

items.heading: יש כח ע"ס באור העליון
items.html: Let us begin to explain the existence of Akudim, what its matter is. Know that the upper light, which is the part fit to clothe in emanation, in which there is the force of the ten Sefirot — although it is not yet discernible that they are 40ten lights, but only after the completion of Akudim — indeed certainly 50the force of these ten lights was in them at first; only, since 60the light was not limited inside the vessel, 70the existence of their being ten was not yet discernible.

items.heading: המשיך אור העקודים מפה עד הטבור, וחזר ונסתלק למקורו לפה
items.html: And behold, when the upper Emanator wished to bring out that phase of vessel which is called Akudim, what did He do? He drew His light downward, until the existence of the Sium of the measure fit to have the phase of 80Akudim made from it, which is from the Peh [mouth] to the Tabur; 90and after He drew it, that light departed and rose again 100to its source in the Peh.

items.heading: רשימה שנשארה אחר הסתלקות האור נתהווה לבחינת כלי
items.html: And it is known that the upper light, when it expands and then again becomes concealed, necessarily leaves the impression of a seal below. And behold, that light, which is the record that remains below — when the upper light departed and was concealed in its source, then that light of the record remained below without that upper light, and then, through the distancing of the light that remained, the phase of a vessel came into being, 200for the cause of the expansion of the light and of its departure afterwards brought about the making of the existence of a vessel.

items.heading: לפי שהאור נסתלק בבת אחת נעשה רק כלי אחד, ונקרא כתר
items.html: And since, when the first light departed once more, it departed 300all at once and in a single moment, therefore the whole existence of the light that remained became the existence of one vessel, and it is called the phase of a vessel, which is called Keter [crown], for the upper light was not yet divided into ten Sefirot, since it was not yet discernible that they were ten Sefirot. And the reason it is called Keter and not some other Sefira is that Keter is always near the Emanator.

items.heading: ונבחנות ע"ס בכלי זה, ע"פ התרחקותן מבחי"ד, דהיינו ע"פ ד' בחינות שבאור העליון
items.html: Indeed, although we have explained that there is in this vessel the existence of a vessel of Malchut and Yesod, etc., they are not called ten vessels on that account, since there is as yet no discernment of their being ten Sefirot, and also because the light departed all together. Rather, the matter is like the likeness of one long vessel whose parts are not equal, 400according to the distance of those parts one from another.
